name: Find My
description: macOS-only. Read-only. Query locations of friends who have already opted in to share with this Mac's Apple ID by reading FindMy.app through macOS Accessibility. Returns name, coarse location, staleness, and distance, never coordinates or history. It cannot surface anyone who has not consented or bypass Apple access controls. Shells out to the `findmy` binary and requires Accessibility permission.

cliPath.description: Path to the findmy binary. Defaults to PATH lookup.

cliPath.label: CLI Path
cliPath.help: Path or command name for this fork's findmy binary. Build LPFchan/findmy-cli from source and point this setting or FINDMY_CLI_PATH to bin/findmy.
